name: Intel
summary:
Intel’s tab icon is the mark intel.com serves for the chip maker’s site. It is not the “Intel Inside” sticker art from a retail box unless that is the file the host actually returned.

Checked 12 November 2026 against intel.com. HTML came from https://www.intel.com/ (HTTP 403). No icon link tags were readable in the HTML. Files below came from a manifest or from a path that returned an image.

The favicon.ico URL is https://www.intel.com/favicon.ico. The saved file favicon.ico is 4286 bytes. Directory sizes: 32×32.

No apple-touch-icon URL was declared, and the well-known apple-touch-icon.png path did not return an image.

No brand colour could be derived. The page had no theme-color, mask-icon colour, or manifest theme_color, and a dominant pixel colour was not readable from the saved PNGs.

The only measured sizes are inside favicon.ico: 32×32.
